sample_size_requirements.power_rationale: Phase 7 power modeling proves n=300 has only 32.2% power for delta=-0.0045; n=1,050 achieves >= 80% power at alpha=0.05.

cohort_eligibility_criteria.no_reused_oos_fixtures: Existing 300 OOS fixtures (REUSED_HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_OOS) are strictly excluded from the prospective count.

causal_prediction_contract.stage_1_prediction_lock: Model probabilities (V4, DC, Elo, Champion) must be computed and cryptographically locked BEFORE kickoff.
causal_prediction_contract.stage_2_outcome_join: Match outcomes (FT result, goals) joined post-match via fixture_id without altering original prediction records.
forbidden_inputs: Future match results or future Elo states
Market closing probabilities used as model features

evaluation_metrics.primary_comparison: Frozen Champion vs V4 Independent Poisson Baseline
secondary_metrics: Mean Predicted P(Draw) vs Observed Draw Rate

statistical_decision_rules.decision_rule: The two-tailed 95% bootstrap confidence interval for Delta Log Loss must strictly exclude zero (CI upper < 0.0).
mandatory_promotion_gates: 1. Minimum sample size N >= 1,050 fixtures satisfied.
3. Paired bootstrap 95% CI strictly excludes zero.
4. Secondary metrics (Brier, RPS) show no material degradation.
5. Stable performance across chronological 50- and 100-match buckets.
6. Zero leakage or prediction modification verified.

withhold_promotion_if: Improvement concentrated entirely in a single short bucket or league
